item.title: Troubled LA Mayor Karen Bass faces a re-election challenge from the city’s left wing
item.description: City Councilwoman Nithya Raman declared her candidacy with a few hours to spare. A left leaning progressive, she'd previously endorsed Bass.

item.title: Housing advocates still waiting for state-ordered stair report
item.description: California’s fire safety regulators were asked to study whether mid-rise apartments can go with a single staircase. They’re more than a month late.

item.title: Hospitals’ opaque pricing is crushing California’s small businesses
item.description: Hospitals often charge California’s small businesses more than Medicare for the same treatments and tack on hidden “facilities fees.”

item.title: Overtime pay and night vision binoculars: UC San Diego is among agencies helping patrol border
item.description: Local police forces get money every year from the Department of Homeland Security to assist with border patrol operations. This includes the UC San Diego Police Department, which helps monitor for smuggling along the coastline.

item.title: CA’s local police still collaborating with Border Patrol
item.description: California Democratic officials often tout California as a sanctuary state, but some local police departments — including police at UC San Diego — have been participating in a federal program that provides agencies millions of dollars to collaborate with Border Patrol, writes Phoebe Huss of CalMatters’ College Journalism Network. item.title: California demanda a sitios web que publican planos de pistolas fantasma para impresoras 3D
item.description: Las fuerzas del orden de California incautan unas 11,000 armas fantasma al año. El estado está demandando a los sitios web que ayudan a fabricar armas de fuego imposibles de rastrear.

item.title: Activistas de la vivienda aún esperan informe sobre las escaleras ordenado por el estado
item.description: Se solicitó a los reguladores de seguridad contra incendios de California que estudiaran si los apartamentos de mediana altura pueden tener una sola escalera de incendio. Llevan más de un mes de retraso.

item.title: Horas extras y binoculares de visión nocturna: UC San Diego es una de las agencias ayudando a patrullar la frontera
item.description: Las fuerzas policiales locales reciben fondos cada año del Departamento de Seguridad Nacional para apoyar las operaciones de patrullaje fronterizo. Esto incluye al Departamento de Policía de la Universidad de California en San Diego, que ayuda a controlar el contrabando en la costa.

item.title: Are TikTok and X tracking you across the internet? Our privacy tool can tell you
item.description: We’ve updated Blacklight, The Markup’s privacy inspector, to help you understand how sites are tracking you.

item.title: Newsom takes aim at veterans ‘claim sharks’ as he signs law banning fees for help with VA
item.description: Many veterans turn to private companies for help filing disability claims at the Department of Veterans Affairs and then face bills that run well into the thousands of dollars.
